posts.title_en: Why people say you have to see Princess Bari's coefficients to know
posts.summary_en: Pre-release speculation on Princess Bari's skill: besides CC immunity and damage reduction, her buff on allied charge-type (돌격형) cookies deals periodic AoE damage (blue flame aura). Whether that damage scales off Bari's ATK or the buffed cookie's ATK decides whether charge decks rise; author expects in raid/Crumble she'll just be added next to 피겨/뱀파. A commenter says the leak says it scales on the buffed cookie's ATK.
mechanics: Image 1 (skill text): '영혼 인도' — dashes toward the highest-ATK enemy dealing damage, wraps self and allied 돌격형 cookies in a soul granting 피해감소, 띄우기/밀치기 면역, and damage to nearby enemies.
Image 2: gameplay capture of blue flame/slash aura around a cookie (the periodic AoE).
Author: charge cookies tend to break the ally formation; Bari's dash is slow, seemingly designed around Milk (우유) buff range.
Commenter (ㅇㅇ 1): leak says the aura damage uses the buffed cookie's ATK; others argue caster-ATK is more typical for skill descriptions.
disagreements: Whether aura damage scales on Bari's ATK (then Milk-buffed Bari makes 오방 a launch pad) vs the buffed cookie's ATK (then 오방, who never gets Milk buff, is out).

quotes.kr: 그리고 어떤 루트를 가던 크던에서 안쓰던 돌격은 계속 개좆병신이라 계수가 개좋아도 걍 쓰던 피겨 뱀파에 바리만 추가될 가능성이 높음
quotes.en: Whatever route, charge cookies unused in Crumble stay trash, so even with great coefficients Bari will likely just be added to the 피겨/뱀파 we already use.

quotes.kr: 유출 보니 버프 받은 쿠키 공격력이 기준임
quotes.en: Per the leak it's based on the buffed cookie's ATK.

Also max-stage recommended power drops ~36%. Commenters read it mostly as an arena/PvP shake-up (crit damage becomes worthless vs Moon Rabbit).

달토끼 9성: 공감 50%, 치명감소 130%, 범위 4.2? (proc chance/duration not given; commenters asked).
막스테 권장투력 ~36% reduced (patch).

quotes.en: Princess Bari 9★: damage reduction 40%
Moon Rabbit 9★: ATK reduction 50%, crit reduction 130%, range 4.2?
These are datamine values I only skimmed, so not sure.
Also max-stage recommended power is reduced ~36%.

posts.title_en: Arena/raid gear recommendation
posts.summary_en: Author compares two necklaces for arena/raid: equipped Eternal one with 치확 + 스가 (higher power) vs Legendary one with 스증 + 스가 (17.46M less power). Reply: memorize '스가스증' — skill amp wins despite lower power.

gear.substats: Image A (equipped): 이터널 '덧없는 허무의 목걸이' Lv97 +15, main 치명저항 34.03%, subs 치확 21.71%, 스가 +4.60, 전투력 130.48M. Image B: 레전더리 '은은한 향기를 품은 해독제' Lv99 +15, main 치명저항 33.04%, subs 스증 7.15%, 스가 +4.60, 전투력 113.02M (-17.46M).

mechanics: Displayed 전투력 does not reflect raid value of 스증 vs 치확.

quotes.en: Memorize it: skill haste, skill amp.

posts.title_en: Ugh, Bright Seeker sugar rune
posts.summary_en: Bright Seeker rune with 7 SSR 스가 lines (4/5/5/4/4/4/5 = +31) and the last C line (회피율 1.20%) still being rolled — author says ~300k crystals went into the last line alone. Debate: one says 스가 only needs a threshold (40–45) and the rest should be 스증; author pulls 스증/치확/치피 from gear and 스가 from the rune; reply that uptime differences make up to 50 worthwhile (6 drones).

sugar_runes.stats: Image: C 회피율 1.20% (unlocked, being rerolled), SSR 스가 +4, +5, +5, +4, +4, +4, +5 (7 lines, +31 total).
sugar_runes.why: Author: get 스증/치확/치피 from gear and 스가 from rune because numerically better.

rng: ~300k sugar crystals (author's estimate) spent on rerolling the final rune line.
mechanics: Claim: 스가 above 40–45 is heard to be pointless since next cap is far higher; counter-claim: 6 drones aren't permanently up, so uptime keeps improving to 50.
disagreements: ㅇㅇ 1: take a fixed amount of 스가 and the rest 스증; 40–45+ is meaningless and over-hasted given gear 스가. Author/reply: uptime (가동률) differs, so good up to 50.

quotes.en: I think the last line alone has eaten 300k.

quotes.kr: 장비에서 스증 치확 치피를 땡기고 슈가룬에서 스가로 땡길라고 수치상 그게 더 좋길래
quotes.en: I'm pulling 스증/치확/치피 from gear and 스가 from the sugar rune, since that's numerically better.

quotes.kr: 40-45 이상 맞춰봤자 의미없다고 들었는데 다음 스가캡이 한참 위라
quotes.en: I heard going beyond 40–45 is meaningless since the next haste cap is far above.

quotes.kr: 근데 거기서도 6드론 상시 유지 이런게 아니라 가동률 차이나서 50까진 좋다던데
quotes.en: But even there 6 drones aren't permanently maintained; uptime differs, so they say up to 50 is good.

posts.title_en: In the raid Cherry deck
posts.summary_en: Q: why exactly is Cherry in the Cherry deck (some use Melon Soda)? Answers: it's one way to make Seeker receive Macaron's buff well; each cookie included slightly changes starting placement, and Cherry is there to make the formation a straight line. Other says deck choice makes little difference as long as Seeker is buffed.
mechanics: Starting placement shifts depending on which cookies are in the deck; Cherry is included to force a straight-line (1자) formation.
Goal of Cherry/Melon Soda variants: get 시커 inside 마카롱's buff.

quotes.en: Bottom line, it's one way of making Seeker receive Macaron's buff well.

quotes.kr: 들어가는 쿠키마다 시작할때 배치가 살짝 바뀌는데 배치 1자로 만드려고 체리 드는겨
quotes.en: Starting placement changes slightly per cookie; Cherry is brought to make the formation a straight line.

posts.title_en: Why is my raid score so low
posts.summary_en: Cherry-deck screenshot: 72G 82M at 752.83M team power (~96배), 4th personal rank; same 12-cookie layout as 75400 but the Lv.45/90 slot is Lv.1 and one Lv.100 slot is Lv.80. Advice: retry count is the issue; replace 정전 with 허브 if someone dies at 30s; level the others to ~3.5M HP while keeping ATK order. Author says they do survive 30s and use 스증스가 raid gear.

teams.name: 체리덱 (author 지지말아요)

? (row2 c5, light, white hair glasses + guild badge)

substitutions: If a cookie dies at 30s: remove 정전, add 허브 (commenter).
unorthodox: 4 Lv.1 cookies + Lv.1 in the 전갈 slot (Lv.1 fillers).

rng: Commenter: the problem is number of tries (트라이수), implying infinite retries (무한 리트).
mechanics: 17s checkpoint: must survive to 17s; 30s slam kills cookies.
Suggestion: raise other cookies' levels until ~3.5M HP each, within limits that keep ATK order intact.

quotes.en: The number of tries is the problem.

quotes.kr: 30초에 누군가 죽는다면 정전 빼고 허브 넣는게 나음
quotes.en: If someone dies at 30s, better to drop Jungle Warrior and put in Herb.

quotes.kr: 나머지들을 체력 3.5m 정도 될 정도로만 렙을 맞춰봐 공순서는 지킬수 있을 정도 선에서
quotes.en: Level the others just enough to have ~3.5M HP, within the range that keeps the ATK order.

posts.title_en: Newbie getting 17x in raid — what level is that?
posts.summary_en: Newbie at 22M power scores ~380M (~17배) copying the raid deck with 전갈/피노/정글 at Lv.1; Seeker 6★, cannot survive to 17s. Replies: 15x+ is good at that power; surviving to 17s and Seeker 5★+ matter; survival comes from gear and 돌파력 research raising DEF/HP/DR.

teams.name: 토벌덱 (newbie copy)
unorthodox: 전갈 also at Lv.1 here (vs Lv.10–90 in other posts).

mechanics: Surviving until 17s remaining/elapsed and Seeker ≥5★ are key; survival via gear + 돌파력 research (DEF, HP, DR).

quotes.kr: 대충 15배 이상만 되면 잘치는거일걸 그 투력에선
quotes.en: At that power, around 15x+ counts as hitting well.
What matters is surviving to the 17s mark and Seeker being 5★+.

quotes.kr: 그건그냥 장비랑 돌파력 연구로 방어 체력 피감 올려야함
quotes.en: For that you just raise DEF/HP/DR through gear and breakthrough research.

posts.title_en: Deciding how to do Bright Seeker's sugar rune
posts.summary_en: Pre-10★ Bright Seeker rune with 6 active lines (3 스가, 1 스증, 2 치피) and 2 lines locked until ★10. Author considers rerolling both 치피 into 스가. Replies: all-스가 is the standard ('국룰'); skill stacks; one dissent '10성기준 스가4 스증6 정배'.

sugar_runes.why: Considering replacing both 치피 with 스가.

sugar_runes.stats: 스가4 스증6 (박모모; meaning ambiguous — rune has 8 lines, may refer to lines or values)

posts.title_en: Gear presets are confusing — is my plan right?
posts.summary_en: Author plans stage/arena/raid presets: stage = 명중/집중 line, arena = 스가/스증/피감, raid = 회피/스증/피감. Replies: 전투력 only matters for stage; one commenter isn't sure a raid preset is needed at all and gives a per-slot arena layout (top-left 스증+치확, bottom-left 피감+치저, top-right 스증+스가, bottom-right 스가 + 치저/피감) and stage accuracy/focus ~1000/1100.

gear.substats: 명중 + 집중 one line, then max power; target 명중/집중 ~1000/1000 (commenter has 1000/1100 at stage 270-10)
스증 + 치확 best; 치피 also valid; 명중 1 line situationally
스증 + 스가 best; otherwise 스가 fixed + 치확/치피

mechanics: 전투력 (displayed power) only matters for stage content.
disagreements: Commenter questions whether a separate raid preset is needed at all.

quotes.en: Power only matters for stages.

quotes.kr: 왼쪽 윗줄 무기류는 스증 치확이 베스트라 생각함 치피도 유효옵 맞음 명중은 때에 따라서 1줄 정도 챙기는 것도 ㄱㅊ 왼쪽 아래는 피감치저 오른쪽 장비 윗줄은 스증 스가가 베스트 그 외엔 스가 고정 치확 치피등 챙기면 됨 아랫줄은 스가 고정에 치저나 피감 집으면 됨
quotes.en: Top-left weapons: 스증+치확 best, 치피 valid, 1 line of accuracy OK sometimes. Bottom-left: DR+crit res. Right top: 스증+스가 best, else fixed 스가 plus crit/crit dmg. Right bottom: fixed 스가 plus crit res or DR.

posts.title_en: Raid gear preset: crit rate vs crit damage
posts.summary_en: Author: top-right 스가+스증; top-left is it 스증+치확 (arena) and 스증+치피 (raid)? Replies: just take higher 스증; another says the opposite — raid doesn't use 치피, only 치확, with 스증 main; a third notes 치피 is bad in arena due to 치저.

quotes.kr: 반대임 아레나는 굳이 쓸거면 치피 써도 되는데 토벌은 치피 안 씀 치확만 씀 써도 스증이 메인이고

posts.title_en: Hit 641x with the Cherry deck

ATK order 우유 브시 피겨 카롱 실론 치케 전갈; 4 Lv.1 cookies (체리 닼초 피노 정전) and 전갈 raised to Lv.45 deliberately so Pomegranate's straw goes to Scorpion rather than Dark Choco when Ceylon misses Milk's buff. Pets 와사비문어/핫도그/색동주머니 all ★20. Gear: 스가 6 + 스증 6, rest crit/crit dmg, spare slots DR; no move speed anywhere; team wipes at 17s; ~1T once or twice per 10 runs, occasionally 1.1T.

posts.title_en: Is crit rate needed in raid?
posts.summary_en: Author: boss has no crit res so is crit rate needed? Answers: crit rate above 100% keeps adding — every 100% of crit rate adds another crit-damage instance (200% = crits twice; 198% = one crit plus 98% chance of a second). So crit rate is 'more is better'; one says always double crit rate (치확 둘둘). Unresolved whether 치확 or 치피 is better when forced to choose.
rng: Crit rate beyond a 100% multiple is a probability for one additional crit.
mechanics: Boss appears to have no crit res; author sees red (crit) numbers.
Crit rate over 100%: each 100% (100/200/300/400) adds another crit-damage application; 198% = 1 guaranteed crit + 98% chance of a second.
disagreements: 340 assumed crit rate is only for overcoming arena crit res; commenters say it scales past 100% so it matters in raid.
Unresolved: 치확 vs 치피 when forced to choose ('몰루 걍 반반').

quotes.kr: 근데 크럼블은 치명 100퍼 넘어가면 치명피해가 여러번 들어가서 다다익선이지
quotes.en: In Crumble, above 100% crit, crit damage applies multiple times, so more is better.

quotes.kr: 이게임은 치확 100 200 300 400마다 치피가 그만큼 추가로 들어가서 그럼
quotes.en: In this game, each 100/200/300/400 of crit rate adds crit damage again.
(At 198%) one crit, then a 98% chance for one more.
Always double crit rate.

posts.title_en: Raid gear recommendation please
posts.summary_en: 340 set weapons all to 스증+치피 and compares Lv98 wand (스증 7.47% + 치피 14.53%) vs Lv103 wand (치확 16.51% + 스증 8.00%). Replies favour the latter: 1.4 crit rate ≈ 1 crit dmg in value, but higher 스증 always wins; aim for +15 pieces with 치확/치피 20%+ and 스증 9%+. 340 notes their arena set (치확) scored lower in raid than the raid set (치피).

gear.substats: Left (equipped): 이터널 '환상을 여는 꿈빛지팡이' Lv98 +15, main 치명확률 34.85%, subs 스증 7.47%, 치피 14.53%, power 249.17M. Right: Lv103 +15, main 치명확률 37.72%, subs 치확 16.51%, 스증 8.00%, power 279.52M (+30.35M).

mechanics: 캔디애플: 치확 1.4 ≈ 치피 1 in value; 스증 always higher priority.
disagreements: 340: arena set (치확) scored worse in raid than raid set (치피), contrary to 75038/75589 commenters favouring 치확.

quotes.kr: 치확 1.4랑 치피 1이랑 비슷함 근데 무조건 스증높은게 우위임
quotes.en: 1.4 crit rate is about the same as 1 crit dmg, but higher skill amp is always better.

quotes.kr: 아레나셋은 치확이고 토벌셋은 치피인데 아레나셋으로 치니까 더 안나오더라고
quotes.en: My arena set is crit rate and raid set crit dmg, and with the arena set I scored less.

quotes.kr: 15강 기준 치확 치피 20퍼 이상 스증 9퍼이상 뜨는경우있는데 그거 노리자
quotes.en: At +15 you can get crit rate/crit dmg 20%+ and skill amp 9%+; aim for that.
